description: Header file defining the gl::Buffer class and related BufferState class, implementing OpenGL buffer objects and their management.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL buffer object, managing its state, data, and interactions with the implementation.

classes.name: BufferState
classes.description: Holds the state information of a Buffer, such as usage, size, access flags, and binding counts.

methods.name: bufferData
methods.description: Initializes or updates the buffer data store.

methods.name: bufferSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of the buffer data store.

methods.name: copyBufferSubData
methods.description: Copies data from another buffer object.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the entire buffer for access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer for access.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Retrieves the index range for drawing.
